outputs.L3:
A moving platform operates multiple applications using a communications system capable of transmitting data wirelessly over several communication links. A data management module receives performance information indicating the bandwidth currently available on each link associated with the platform’s applications.

For each application, the system identifies data awaiting transmission and determines its bandwidth requirements. It then compares those requirements with the available bandwidth of the communication link assigned to the application. If the link does not provide sufficient bandwidth, the system notifies the affected application or its associated quality-of-service interface.

In response, the application or quality-of-service interface modifies one or more parameters of the pending data so that its bandwidth requirements align with the capacity of the assigned link. Such adjustments may include reducing data resolution, compression level, transmission rate, packet size, or another quality-related parameter. Once adapted, the data is transmitted over the wireless communication link within the available bandwidth.
outputs.L4:
A communications management system for a moving platform, such as an aircraft, ship, train, or ground vehicle, manages data transmission over multiple wireless communication links. These links may include satellite, cellular, radio-frequency, or other wireless networks, each of which may provide different and continuously changing levels of available bandwidth as the platform moves. The system monitors the capacity and operating condition of the supported links and determines the bandwidth currently available for application traffic.

Applications operating on or communicating through the moving platform provide the communications management system with information describing their transmission requirements. Such information may include a desired or minimum data rate, latency tolerance, priority, reliability requirement, or other quality-of-service parameters. The system compares these requirements with the bandwidth and service characteristics of the wireless link selected for each application.

When the selected link cannot provide sufficient capacity to satisfy an application’s transmission requirements, the system generates a notification. The notification may be delivered directly to the application or through an associated quality-of-service interface. It may identify the available bandwidth, indicate that a requested service level cannot be maintained, or provide revised operating limits based on current link conditions.

In response, the affected application adjusts one or more data-generation or transmission parameters. For example, it may reduce a media encoding rate, lower image resolution or frame frequency, increase compression, decrease update frequency, defer nonessential data, or otherwise limit the amount of information being transmitted. If additional capacity later becomes available, the application may increase its transmission rate or restore a higher quality level.

By coordinating link-capacity monitoring with application-level adaptation, the system allows available wireless resources to be used efficiently without requiring communications to stop whenever network conditions deteriorate. The approach supports reliable transmission across changing coverage areas and link conditions while enabling applications to maintain the best practicable quality of service within the bandwidth currently available.

counterfactuals.prompt: Draft a patent-style abstract for a method and apparatus that manages communications bandwidth for applications on a moving platform by monitoring link capacity and prompting applications to adapt their data when bandwidth is insufficient.
counterfactuals.output: A method and apparatus are provided for managing communication bandwidth for applications operating on a moving platform. A bandwidth management system monitors a capacity of at least one communication link between the moving platform and a remote network and determines bandwidth requirements associated with application data awaiting transmission. When the available link capacity is insufficient to satisfy the determined bandwidth requirements, the system generates and communicates an adaptation request to one or more applications. In response, an application modifies its data or transmission behavior, including by compressing data, reducing data resolution or update frequency, prioritizing selected content, aggregating transmissions, or deferring noncritical data. The system may continuously reassess link capacity and application demand and may allocate bandwidth according to application priority, data type, platform location, link condition, or operational policy. The disclosed approach enables dynamic application-level adaptation to changing communication conditions while reducing congestion and maintaining transmission of higher-priority information.
counterfactuals.label: cf_1

counterfactuals.prompt: Write a single patent claim describing adaptive quality-of-service management across multiple wireless communication links for applications operating aboard a mobile platform.
counterfactuals.output: 1. A method for adaptive quality-of-service management aboard a mobile platform, the method comprising: establishing, by a communication controller of the mobile platform, concurrent connectivity over a plurality of wireless communication links having different link characteristics; receiving traffic generated by a plurality of applications operating aboard the mobile platform; determining, for each application, a quality-of-service requirement based on an application type, a traffic characteristic, or an operational priority; obtaining link-state information for each wireless communication link, the link-state information comprising at least one of available bandwidth, latency, packet-loss rate, signal quality, coverage availability, monetary cost, or predicted link duration; dynamically assigning respective portions of the traffic to selected wireless communication links based on the quality-of-service requirements and the link-state information; monitoring performance of the assigned traffic; and, in response to determining that monitored performance for an application fails or is predicted to fail to satisfy its quality-of-service requirement, automatically modifying the assignment of traffic among the plurality of wireless communication links, including aggregating links, switching links, or adjusting a traffic-scheduling priority, to maintain the quality-of-service requirement while the mobile platform is in motion.
counterfactuals.label: cf_2

counterfactuals.prompt: Describe, in formal patent language, a communications management system that compares each application’s bandwidth requirements with currently available bandwidth and directs the application or its QoS interface to adjust transmission parameters.
counterfactuals.output: A communications management system comprising: a bandwidth-monitoring module configured to determine an amount of bandwidth currently available over at least one communications link; an application-monitoring module configured to obtain, for each of a plurality of applications, bandwidth requirement information indicative of bandwidth requested or required by the respective application; and a control module communicatively coupled to the bandwidth-monitoring module and the application-monitoring module. The control module is configured to compare the bandwidth requirement information for each application with the currently available bandwidth and, in response to determining that the bandwidth requirement of an application is inconsistent with the currently available bandwidth, generate a control instruction directed to the application or to a quality-of-service interface associated with the application. The control instruction causes adjustment of one or more transmission parameters, including at least one of a transmission rate, packet size, encoding rate, compression level, resolution, frame rate, traffic priority, latency target, retransmission policy, or scheduling interval, thereby adapting transmission by the application to the currently available bandwidth.
counterfactuals.label: cf_3

counterfactuals.prompt: Create patent claim text for a data management module that detects insufficient communication-link bandwidth, sends notification data to the affected application, and causes that application to adapt at least one data parameter before transmission to a recipient node.
counterfactuals.output:
### What is claimed is:

1. **A system for managing data transmission, comprising:**  
   a communication interface configured to communicate with a recipient node over a communication link; and  
   a data management module comprising one or more processors and memory storing instructions that, when executed by the one or more processors, cause the data management module to:  
   determine an available bandwidth of the communication link;  
   determine that the available bandwidth is insufficient for transmission, by an application, of data having a current value of at least one data parameter;  
   responsive to determining that the available bandwidth is insufficient, generate notification data identifying a bandwidth constraint associated with the communication link;  
   provide the notification data to the application; and  
   cause the application, based on the notification data and before transmission of the data to the recipient node, to modify the current value of the at least one data parameter to produce adapted data for transmission over the communication link.

2. **The system of claim 1**, wherein determining that the available bandwidth is insufficient comprises comparing the available bandwidth with a bandwidth requirement determined from the current value of the at least one data parameter.

3. **The system of claim 1**, wherein the at least one data parameter comprises at least one of a data rate, a bit rate, a resolution, a frame rate, a sampling rate, a compression level, an encoding format, a packet size, a transmission frequency, or an amount of data included in a transmission.

4. **The system of claim 1**, wherein the notification data comprises at least one of the available bandwidth, a target bandwidth, an identifier of the communication link, a requested reduction in data rate, or a recommended value of the at least one data parameter.

5. **The system of claim 1**, wherein the data management module is further configured to determine the available bandwidth based on at least one of measured throughput, packet loss, latency, jitter, link utilization, a congestion indication, or a bandwidth allocation received from a network device.

6. **The system of claim 1**, wherein causing the application to modify the current value comprises invoking an application programming interface exposed by the application and supplying, through the application programming interface, at least a portion of the notification data.

7. **The system of claim 1**, wherein the adapted data has a lower bandwidth requirement than the data having the current value of the at least one data parameter.

8. **The system of claim 1**, wherein the data management module is further configured to:  
   determine, after the application modifies the current value, that a bandwidth requirement of the adapted data satisfies a bandwidth criterion for the communication link; and  
   authorize transmission of the adapted data to the recipient node in response to satisfaction of the bandwidth criterion.

9. **The system of claim 1**, wherein the application is a media application and the data comprises audio data, image data, video data, sensor data, or a combination thereof.

10. **A computer-implemented method for managing data transmission, the method comprising:**  
    determining, by a data management module, an available bandwidth of a communication link between a transmitting node and a recipient node;  
    determining that the available bandwidth is insufficient to transmit application data according to a current value of at least one data parameter;  
    in response to determining that the available bandwidth is insufficient, transmitting notification data from the data management module to an application associated with the application data;  
    causing, by the notification data, the application to modify the current value of the at least one data parameter before transmission of the application data, thereby generating adapted application data; and  
    transmitting the adapted application data to the recipient node over the communication link.

11. **The method of claim 10**, wherein determining that the available bandwidth is insufficient comprises predicting that transmission according to the current value would violate a threshold associated with at least one of throughput, latency, packet loss, jitter, or transmission completion time.

12. **The method of claim 10**, further comprising selecting, by the application based on the notification data, an adapted value from among a plurality of candidate values for the at least one data parameter.

13. **The method of claim 10**, wherein modifying the current value comprises at least one of reducing a resolution, reducing a frame rate, reducing a sampling rate, increasing compression, changing an encoding format, omitting a portion of the application data, or delaying transmission of a portion of the application data.

14. **The method of claim 10**, further comprising:  
    monitoring the available bandwidth during transmission of the adapted application data;  
    detecting a change in the available bandwidth; and  
    providing updated notification data to the application to cause a further modification of the at least one data parameter.

15. **A non-transitory computer-readable medium** storing instructions that, when executed by one or more processors, cause the one or more processors to:  
    obtain information indicative of available bandwidth of a communication link to a recipient node;  
    determine, using the information, that the available bandwidth fails to satisfy a bandwidth requirement associated with transmission of data by an application;  
    responsive to the determination, send notification data to the application, the notification data indicating a bandwidth constraint;  
    cause the application, in response to the notification data, to adapt at least one parameter of the data before the data is transmitted to the recipient node; and  
    initiate transmission of the data having the adapted at least one parameter over the communication link to the recipient node.
counterfactuals.label: cf_5
